title: REGENXBIO Strengthens Board of Directors with Appointment of Greg Ciongoli
summary: REGENXBIO Inc. (Nasdaq: RGNX) today announced the appointment of Greg Ciongoli to its Board of Directors, effective August 25, 2026. With multiple upcoming catalysts across its late-stage pipeline of potential first-and best-in-class gene therapies, Mr. Ciongoli joins the Board as REGENXBIO prepares to become a global commercial organization. Mr. Ciongoli has extensive experience in biotechnology investing, capital allocation and corporate strategy to support the Company's next phase of growth.
